description: This file defines the 'ClientInterface' interface within the PSR HTTP Client namespace, specifying the method for sending HTTP requests and receiving responses following PSR-7 standards.

classes.name: ClientInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for an HTTP client implementing a method to send PSR-7 requests.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a PSR-7 request and returns a PSR-7 response, potentially throwing a ClientExceptionInterface if an error occurs.
